title: GLOOPALAXY
description:
Collect Gloops, astonishing aquatic creatures from outer space, and create the perfect environment for their well-being. Fill up your encyclopedia and pass your 3 semesters to earn your degree in Gloopology!

 

🎣 Catch the Gloops!Using your trusty Gloop Catcher 2000™ remote fishing device, select a destination planet and catch unique Gloops and environments to expand your collection. Make sure to visit each planet during cosmic events, as you may find rare and shiny Gloops!

🐠 Study and care for your GloopsPlace them in different tanks and adjust their ecosystems. Experiment to uncover their preferences and complete your encyclopedia with your discoveries!

✨ Help ScienceSucceed in your semesters by meeting the goals set by your professors. Take on all kinds of outlandish requests and unravel the mysteries of the universe… All to earn your degree in gloopology!

🎨 Customize your spacePlace everything you catch exactly where you want to inside your 3D aquariums. Adjust the color theme and voilà! An expertly designed research base!

• 3 missions to earn your Gloopology diploma

• 3 to 5 hours of gameplay

• 60+ Gloops to collect

• Themes and decorations to customize your aquarium

• A fun and relaxing universe in outer space

• A somewhat helpful robo-cat assistant... 

Dev Team

Gloopalaxy is a small indie game developed by a two-person team, in collaboration with Garance Royère, who created the game’s wonderful creatures!
description_short: Collect and study strange aquatic creatures in Gloopalaxy! Discover new life forms, create the perfect ecosystem for their well-being, and complete all kinds of objectives to earn your diploma.
